campaigns_due_idx.name: campaigns_due_idx
campaigns_due_idx.where: "campaigns"."published_at" is not null and "campaigns"."status" in ('draft','teaser','open') and "campaigns"."archived_at" is null

plan_entitlements_value_check.name: plan_entitlements_value_check
plan_entitlements_value_check.value: ("plan_entitlements"."kind" = 'boolean' and "plan_entitlements"."boolean_value" is not null and "plan_entitlements"."limit_value" is null) or ("plan_entitlements"."kind" = 'limit' and "plan_entitlements"."boolean_value" is null and ("plan_entitlements"."limit_value" is null or "plan_entitlements"."limit_value" >= 0))
